episodes.synopsis: Pikachu is suffering from a serious electrical overload! Can Ash and Professor Birch find a solution before it's too late?
episodes.title: Get the Show on the Road!

episodes.synopsis: A power failure at the Pokémon Center leads Ash and his new friend May to an astonishing discovery!
episodes.title: A Ruin with a View

episodes.synopsis: Ash is ready for his first Gym battle in the Hoenn region--and the Gym Leader he must face is none other than May's father!
episodes.title: There's No Place Like Hoenn

episodes.synopsis: When Team Rocket turns a flock of Taillow against our heroes, an old friend comes to the rescue!
episodes.title: You Never Can Taillow!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends meet an eccentric Trainer who challenges May to her very first Pokémon battle!
episodes.title: In the Knicker of Time!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are on the trail of a Pokémon poacher, and Team Rocket is close behind!
episodes.title: A Poached Ego!

episodes.synopsis: When Ash gets lost in the woods, he meets a Treecko who's determined to save its forest home.
episodes.title: Tree's a Crowd

episodes.synopsis: Ash's Treecko takes on a wild Seviper, but things don't go so well...
episodes.title: A Tail with a Twist

episodes.synopsis: Stopping in Rinshin Town, our heroes investigate the mystery of a haunted mansion!
episodes.title: Taming of the Shroomish

episodes.synopsis: Ash can't resist challenging a Trainer who claims to have the world's most powerful Pokémon, but there's something odd about this battle...
episodes.title: You Said a Mouthful!

episodes.synopsis: After meeting a group of Mightyena, Max befriends a Poochyena who hasn't evolved yet and decides to train it himself!
episodes.title: A Bite to Remember

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes meet three sisters who grow berries with the help of a nearby group of Lotad!
episodes.title: The Lotad Lowdown

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends discover a whole new kind of Pokémon competition, and it seems May has found her calling!
episodes.title: All Things Bright and Beautifly!

episodes.synopsis: As May sets out to catch a Wurmple for her first Pokémon Contest, Ash receives a Double Battle challenge!
episodes.title: All in a Day's Wurmple

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes check out the Pokémon Trainer's School in Rustboro City, where Max has a run-in with a classmate!
episodes.title: Gonna Rule the School!

episodes.synopsis: Armed with Pikachu's new Iron Tail attack, Ash challenges Gym Leader Roxanne!
episodes.title: The Winner by a Nosepass!

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes tour the massive Devon Corporation, a mysterious intruder tries to steal an important piece of equipment!
episodes.title: Stairway to Devon

episodes.synopsis: Mr. Briney the sailor offers to take our heroes to Dewford Island for Ash's next Gym battle, but then changes his mind. What's going on?
episodes.title: On a Wingull and a Prayer!

episodes.synopsis: When a school of Sharpedo attacks, Ash and friends are stranded on an uncharted island!
episodes.title: Sharpedo Attack!

episodes.synopsis: Ash challenges the Dewford Gym, but Gym Leader Brawly seems more interested in surfing!ets the Gym Leader Brawly, who would rather surf than battle, which infuriates Ash. Could there be more to this Gym Leader than meets the eye? And does May even have a shred of decency?
episodes.title: Brave the Wave

episodes.synopsis: May and Jessie of Team Rocket both have a Wurmple, and the two Pokémon accidentally get swapped during a battle!
episodes.title: Which Wurmple's Which?

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends meet Steven Stone in Granite Cave, where they quickly fall into one of Team Rocket's traps!
episodes.title: A Hole Lotta Trouble

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious Pokémon keeps burrowing through the beach near our heroes' camp and knocking over everything in its way!
episodes.title: Gone Corphishin'

episodes.synopsis: When Ash's rowdy new Corphish eats something it shouldn't, he goes on a dangerous journey to get it to the Pokémon Center!
episodes.title: A Corphish Out of Water

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends come across a lake full of Mudkip and soon find themselves protecting the Pokémon from a Team Rocket scheme!
episodes.title: A Mudkip Mission

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes get separated from their Pokémon in a deep, dark cave, both groups find themselves in trouble!
episodes.title: Turning Over a Nuzleaf

episodes.synopsis: Ash and the others meet up with Professor Birch for a day of exploration and end up in the middle of a villainous confrontation!
episodes.title: A Three Team Scheme!

episodes.synopsis: Jessie of Team Rocket is sure her Pokémon will evolve into a lovely Beautifly someday, but she could be in for a rude awakening!
episodes.title: Seeing Is Believing!

episodes.synopsis: Deciding it's time to teach his unruly Corphish a lesson, Ash leads the Pokémon into an abandoned mine, where things are not as they seem...
episodes.title: Ready, Willing, and Sableye

episodes.synopsis: The approach of a dangerous storm calls a halt to Ash's latest battle challenge!
episodes.title: A Meditite Fight!

episodes.synopsis: In a secret island arena with an unusual battlefield, Dewford Gym Leader Brawly welcomes Ash for a rematch!
episodes.title: Just One of the Geysers

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes find themselves aboard an abandoned ship...and then start disappearing one by one!
episodes.title: Abandon Ship!

episodes.synopsis: While May trains for the Pokémon Contest in Slateport City, Torchic's appetite for berries gets her in trouble!
episodes.title: Now That's Flower Power!

episodes.synopsis: A new Trainer is stopping by a Pokémon Center to choose her first partner Pokémon, and Nurse Joy asks Ash and Max to take care of Treecko, Torchic, and Mudkip for her!
episodes.title: Having a Wailord of a Time

episodes.synopsis: It's time for May's first Pokémon Contest! Does her Beautifly have what it takes to win a ribbon?
episodes.title: Win, Lose or Drew!

episodes.synopsis: A day of relaxation in Slateport City turns into a confrontation between Team Rocket and Team Magma!
episodes.title: The Spheal of Approval

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends stop at a Pokémon Center for directions, but there's no sign of Nurse Joy! What could have happened to her?
episodes.title: Jump for Joy!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends visit a lighthouse, where they try to return a stolen item they recovered from Team Rocket--but the lighthouse keepers think our heroes are the thieves!
episodes.title: A Different Kind of Misty!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends join the Trick House Contest, which sends them through a maze full of tricks and traps--and, of course, Team Rocket!
episodes.title: A Poké-BLOCK Party

episodes.synopsis: When Ash challenges the Mauville City Gym, he soon finds himself face to face with the Legendary Pokémon Raikou, or so it would seem...
episodes.title: Watt's with Wattson

episodes.synopsis: When Ash's Treecko and Corphish face Grovyle and Slugma in a double battle, Treecko turns the tables, learning to use Bullet Seed.
episodes.title: What You Seed Is What You Get

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes discover a love story between two Trainers who star with their Pokémon in a local dance festival.
episodes.title: Love at First Flight

episodes.synopsis: A Trainer learns that Pokémon battling requires more than tactics and technology. Meanwhile, a Bagon dreams the impossible dream of taking flight.
episodes.title: Let Bagons Be Bagons

episodes.synopsis: An invitation to the Togepi Festival brings Misty to the Hoenn region, where she learns that a local kingdom bases its rule on the whims of passing Togepi.
episodes.title: The Princess and the Togepi (1)

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes go up against an evil regent who would use Misty's Togepi to steal the throne from its rightful heir!
episodes.title: A Togepi Mirage! (2)

episodes.synopsis: Ash, Brock, May, and Max must all work together to face the four members of a family of skilled Pokémon Trainers and their powerful Pokémon.
episodes.title: Candid Camerupt!

episodes.synopsis: After her Skitty is exhausted by chasing its own tale, May entrusts it to a local aromatherapy house, where it recovers completely.
episodes.title: I Feel Skitty!

episodes.synopsis: A young trainer gains confidence and strengthens his bond with his Zangoose, when he is forced to face Seviper in a less than fair battle.
episodes.title: ZigZag Zangoose!

episodes.synopsis: Max meets another young boy who shares his name, but differs greatly in personality. When this young and inexperienced new acquaintance goes off on his own, Ash and friends must track him down.
episodes.title: Maxxed Out!

episodes.synopsis: As May prepares for her first contest, Ash faces another contestant in a pre-contest battle.
episodes.title: Pros and Con Artists (1)

episodes.synopsis: May wins her first contest, finally earning a ribbon. Jessie of Team Rocket attempts to win by cheating, but is disqualified.
episodes.title: Come What May! (2)

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends meet an old friend who has since joined a Pokémon cheering squad. When they expose his squad for a fake, the trainer is inspired to start anew.
episodes.title: Cheer Pressure

episodes.synopsis: When Team Rocket threatens an innocent family of ranchers, Ash and friends drive them away, with May's Eneko using Assist for the first time.
episodes.title: Game Winning Assist

episodes.synopsis: When Team Aqua and Team Magma battle to gain a meteor on Mount chimney, Ash and friends must put an end to both of their dastardly plans.
episodes.title: Fight for the Meteorite

episodes.synopsis: No sooner has Ash begun an official battle with a novice gym leader, Flannery, than Team Rocket interrupts, postponing the battle for an extra day.
episodes.title: Poetry Commotion!

episodes.synopsis: Ash is battling for his fourth Hoenn region Gym badge! Can his Corphish defeat Flannery's team of Fire types?
episodes.title: Going, Going, Yawn

episodes.synopsis: When rumors arise that a particular Spinda draws happiness to its trainer, Team Rocket quickly hatches a plan to steal this lucky Pokémon.
episodes.title: Going for a Spinda

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends struggle to pass through a valley guarded by territorial Steel Pokémon.
episodes.title: All Torkoal, No Play

episodes.synopsis: While Ash uses his Torkoal to battle the powerful Watson, May faces his assistant with her Skitty.
episodes.title: Manectric Charge

episodes.synopsis: When May's Skitty is injured far from a Pokémon Center, a master in the art of Pokémon massage comes to the rescue!
episodes.title: Delcatty Got Your Tongue

episodes.synopsis: When Ash and friends learn that a masked coordinator is attempting to compete in secret, they help the timid boy hide his identity.
episodes.title: Disaster of Disguise

episodes.synopsis: At Vendanturf Town, the masked trainer makes a strong performance, but loses to May's Skitty, as May wins her second ribbon.
episodes.title: Disguise Da Limit

episodes.synopsis: The people of a small village blame a local drought on the Pokémon Solrock, but it soon comes to light that the drought is in fact the work of Team Rocket.
episodes.title: Take the Lombre Home

episodes.synopsis: May feels a special duty to help a wounded Swablu return to its flock.
episodes.title: True Blue Swablu

episodes.synopsis: Mayhem ensues when Professor Oak inadvertently creates a gigantic Gulpin and Treecko in an effort to stop a Gulpin outbreak.
episodes.title: Gulpin It Down!

episodes.synopsis: Even as Ash's Treecko evolves in the course of battle, his opponent's Loudred does the same. Team Rocket couldn't have picked a worse time to attack.
episodes.title: Exploud and Clear

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends must rely on Grovyle, Torkoal, and Corphish, as they approach Petalburg City.
episodes.title: Go Go Ludicolo!

episodes.synopsis: When May and Max's father, Norman, reaches near celebrity status, Team Rocket pretends to be a part of the family.
episodes.title: A Double Dilemma

episodes.synopsis: Rumors are spreading about Nurse Joy spending a little too much time with Norman, Max and May's father! What's going on?
episodes.title: Love, Petalburg Style!

episodes.synopsis: Ash has challenged Max and May's father, Norman, to a battle before—but this time, it's for a Gym badge!
episodes.title: Balance of Power

episodes.synopsis: When Professor Oak makes a surprise appearance in Hoenn, bringing along Bulbasaur, Charmander, and Squirtle, Ash joins forces with them to battle Team Rocket.
episodes.title: A Six Pack Attack!

episodes.synopsis: When Ash and May face a duo in a double Pokémon battle, a falling out between these two friends causes them to lose--but they soon resolve their differences.
episodes.title: The Bicker the Better

episodes.synopsis: When May accidentally enters a forbidden spot where only grass Pokémon live, she quickly befriends a friendly Bulbasaur.
episodes.title: Grass Hysteria!

episodes.synopsis: May lets her Bulbasaur out of its Pokéball and the curious Pokémon soon gets into trouble.
episodes.title: Hokey Pokéballs

episodes.synopsis: When a famed Whiscash swallows Ash's Gym badges, he teams up with a fisherman to try to reel it in!
episodes.title: Whiscash and Ash

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Pikachu meet up with an aspiring archaeologist who leads them to an ancient and mystical site.
episodes.title: Me, Myself and Time

episodes.synopsis: May prepares to enter her first contest open only to ribbon holders, but remains confident despite seeing the contest favorite and his powerful Masquerain.
episodes.title: A Fan with a Plan

episodes.synopsis: May decides to use Bulbasaur in the Rubello Town Contest. Will its lack of experience cost her a ribbon?
episodes.title: Cruisin' for a Losin?

episodes.synopsis: When a Spoink loses the pearl on its head, Ash and friends volunteer to help search for it.
episodes.title: Pearls Are a Spoink's Best Friend

episodes.synopsis: Ash, May, and Brock participate in a curious sporting event in which players use rings dangling from balloons to catch balls lying on the ground.
episodes.title: That's Just Swellow

episodes.synopsis: Fights arise both between May and Max and amongst Team Rocket, as a Shuppet--a Pokémon that feeds on human anger--stirs them to conflict.
episodes.title: Take This House and Shuppet

episodes.synopsis: Team Rocket infuriates a Breloom, forcing not only themselves, but also Ash and friends to flee from its wrath.
episodes.title: A Shroomish Skirmish

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends learn of Groudon and Kyogre, when Team Magma is joined by a master of disguise.
episodes.title: Unfair-Weather Friends

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends meet up with the beautiful gym leader, Winona, at the Feather Carnival.
episodes.title: Who's Flying Now?

episodes.synopsis: It's Swellow versus Swellow as Ash and Winona battle it out in the Fortree City Gym!
episodes.title: Sky High Gym Battle!

episodes.synopsis: As the heroes continue onwards, they encounter a man pushing his Camerupt. After helping the man, the heroes are told the man, named Elijah, goes around villages and shows movies. The heroes decide to accompany them, while Team Rocket plans on stealing his equipment.
episodes.title: Lights, Camerupt, Action!

episodes.synopsis: A group of conspiracy theorists known as the Pokémon Mystery Club pursues a Lunatone suspected to be behind a recent series of strange events.
episodes.title: Crazy As a Lunatone

episodes.synopsis: A troubled Snorlax wanders into a public park, creating no end of trouble.
episodes.title: The Garden of Eatin'

episodes.synopsis: A fierce bout of amnesia causes Pikachu to join forces with Team Rocket!
episodes.title: A Scare to Remember

episodes.synopsis: Before taking part in the Lilycove Coordinator Contest, May has time to study the art of Pokéblock preparation with a local master
episodes.title: Pokéblock, Stock, and Berry (1)

episodes.synopsis: The Lilycove Coordinator Contest is underway but things are not looking good for May--her Combusken's Fire Spin has spiraled out of control!
episodes.title: Lessons in Lilycove (2)

episodes.synopsis: Hoping to get to Mossdeep Island, Ash and the gang are forced to take a detour.
episodes.title: Judgment Day!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes reconnect with an unlucky Spoink, and it's still having trouble holding onto its pearl!
episodes.title: Clamperl of Wisdom

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends join a treasure hunter to explore the deep sea, but Team Rocket is right behind them!
episodes.title: The Relicanth Really Can

episodes.synopsis: When a Gorebyss-versus-Huntail rivalry develops between two islands, our heroes must get to the bottom of it!
episodes.title: The Evolutionary War

episodes.synopsis: The residents of Muscle Island are dedicated to physical fitness-but can they keep up with Ash in a Pokémon battle?
episodes.title: Training Wrecks

episodes.synopsis: After a rescue at sea, our heroes find themselves aboard Team Magma's submarine and learn more about the group's plan for world domination!
episodes.title: Gaining Groudon (1)

episodes.synopsis: Team Aqua and Team Magma have awakened the ancient Legendary Pokémon Groudon and Kyogre! Can Ash and friends escape?
episodes.title: The Scuffle of Legends (2)

episodes.synopsis: A Team Rocket strike on Mossdeep City drags our heroes-plus the city's twin Gym Leaders-into a space-shuttle scheme!
episodes.title: It's Still Rocket Roll to Me

episodes.synopsis: Ash takes on the Mossdeep Gym, going up against two Gym Leaders at once!
episodes.title: Solid As a Solrock

episodes.synopsis: After winning his seventh Gym badge, Ash can't stop bragging about his battle skills...until he runs into a member of the Elite Four!
episodes.title: Vanity Affair

episodes.synopsis: In an island nature preserve, Ash and friends come face to face with several Pokémon thought to be extinct!
episodes.title: Where's Armaldo?

episodes.synopsis: May competes in a Pokémon Contest, where another Coordinator tries to sabotage her performance!
episodes.title: A Cacturne for the Worse

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes discover an enormous Poké Ball on an island, Team Rocket's meddling unleashes an ancient destructive force!
episodes.title: Claydol Big and Tall

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends meet a talented Trainer who performs a ribbon dance with her Mawile...until Team Rocket gets in the way!
episodes.title: Once in a Mawile

episodes.synopsis: To help a local researcher, our heroes explore a massive underground labyrinth created by a group of Trapinch...and get into some trouble along the way!
episodes.title: Beg, Burrow and Steal

episodes.synopsis: An Absol appears to warn a village of danger, but the villagers think it's the one causing the trouble! Can our heroes clear up this misunderstanding?
episodes.title: Absol-ute Disaster

episodes.synopsis: When a mischievous Snorunt steals Ash's hard-earned Gym badges, Ash chases after it-right into a raging snowstorm!
episodes.title: Let It Snow, Let It Snow, Let It Snorunt

episodes.synopsis: Max finds an injured Ralts and tries to get it to a Pokémon Center, but its friends Gardevoir and Kirlia think our heroes are trying to steal it!
episodes.title: Do I Hear a Ralts?

episodes.synopsis: Ash gets ready for his final Gym battle in the Hoenn region: a Double Battle against Gym Leader Juan, who used to be a Pokémon Coordinator!
episodes.title: The Great Eight Fate! (1)

episodes.synopsis: Ash and Juan battle it out in the Sootopolis Gym! Can Ash win his eighth Gym badge to qualify for the Hoenn League?
episodes.title: Eight Ain't Enough (2)

episodes.synopsis: When May discovers that two of her Poké Balls are missing, she naturally assumes it's Team Rocket! But the culprit could be someone else entirely...
episodes.title: Showdown at Linoone!

episodes.synopsis: When Team Rocket interrupts a practice battle between May and her rival Drew, our heroes and their Pokémon have to sort out a big mix-up!
episodes.title: Who, What, When, Where, Wynaut?

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are delayed by a herd of Donphan on their way to Pacifidlog Town! Can May make it onto the ferry in time for her final Pokémon Contest?
episodes.title: Date Expectations

episodes.synopsis: May enters the Pacifidlog Contest, where she goes up against rivals Joshua and Erica, plus a mysterious competitor known only as "The Jester"...
episodes.title: Mean with Envy (1)

episodes.synopsis: May competes against an unusual Meowth in the second round of the Pacifidlog Contest. Can she win the last ribbon she needs to qualify for the Grand Festival?
episodes.title: Pacifidlog Jam (2)

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes stumble upon a wonderful berry harvest, May takes the opportunity to make some Pokéblocks for the Grand Festival, drawing the attention of a hungry Munchlax!
episodes.title: Berry, Berry Interesting

episodes.synopsis: Ash meets Morrison, another Trainer who's on his way to compete in the Hoenn League, and the two immediately become fierce rivals!
episodes.title: Less Is Morrison

episodes.synopsis: Aboard a luxury liner bound for Slateport City and the Grand Festival, our heroes must help Officer Jenny catch a master thief!
episodes.title: The Ribbon Cup Caper!

episodes.synopsis:
This is a clipshow Unaired outside of Japan of Satoshi's (Ash's) gym battles and Haruka's (May's) contest battles.

The heroes are still on the boat looking towards the Grand Festival. Ash remembers all of his Hoenn Gym Battles with Roxanne, Norman, Brawly, Juan, Tate and Lisa, while May remembers her Contests with Drew, Grace, Kelly, Harley, Erica and Savannah.
episodes.title: Satoshi and Haruka! Heated Battles in Hoenn!!

episodes.synopsis: On the first day of the Grand Festival, May runs into her deceitful rival Harley once more!
episodes.title: Hi Ho Silver Wind! (1)

episodes.synopsis: Ash meets a Coordinator whose ribbons have been stolen, and May listens to some bad advice before her first performance in the Grand Festival!
episodes.title: Deceit and Assist (2)

episodes.synopsis: May is up against Harley in the second round of the Grand Festival! Can she triumph over his treacherous tactics?
episodes.title: Rhapsody in Drew (3)

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes win free tickets to Ever Grande City for the Hoenn League Championships, they're delighted-until it becomes clear this is another of Team Rocket's schemes!
episodes.title: Island Time

episodes.synopsis: While training for the Hoenn League, Ash meets fellow Trainer Tyson and his Meowth in boots, and they discover that the ceremonial torch has been stolen!
episodes.title: Like a Meowth to a Flame

episodes.synopsis: Ash, Morrison, and Tyson register for the Hoenn League, and it appears that Tyson's Meowth has an unfortunate past...
episodes.title: Saved by the Beldum

episodes.synopsis: In the qualifying rounds, Ash faces a serious challenge: he has to win three matches in a row, and each match is a Double Battle!
episodes.title: From Brags to Riches

episodes.synopsis: Ash has made it through the qualifying rounds, but now he faces an impressive Trainer named Katie in a full battle, where both of them will use all six of their Pokémon!
episodes.title: Shocks and Bonds (1)

episodes.synopsis: Ash has fallen behind in his full battle against Katie! Can he recover and make it to the second round?
episodes.title: A Judgment Brawl (2)

episodes.synopsis: Ash faces his friend and rival Morrison in the second round of the Hoenn League!
episodes.title: Choose It or Lose It! (3)

episodes.synopsis: Ash goes up against his rival Tyson in the quarterfinals of the Hoenn League!
episodes.title: At the End of the Fray (4)

episodes.synopsis: The Hoenn League is over, and it's time for Ash to bid farewell to his traveling companions and head home-but he can't resist one more challenge from a Gym Leader along the way!
episodes.title: The Scheme Team

episodes.synopsis: Max and May come to visit Ash in Pallet Town, along with Misty and Brock, and they all make plans for another journey together-this time, to the Battle Frontier!
episodes.title: The Right Place and the Right Mime

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes stop for a picnic at the base of Mt. Moon, where they encounter the rarely seen Cleffa, Clefairy, and Clefable!
episodes.title: A Real Cleffa-Hanger

episodes.synopsis: On the way to Ash's first match at the Battle Frontier, our heroes see the Legendary Pokémon Articuno flying through a snowstorm!
episodes.title: Numero Uno Articuno

episodes.synopsis: Ash calls in his old friend Charizard to help in his battle against Frontier Brain Noland and his friend Articuno!
episodes.title: The Symbol Life

episodes.synopsis: Provoked by Team Rocket, hordes of Rock-type Pokémon attack our heroes on their way to the Battle Arena!
episodes.title: Hooked on Onix

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends fall into a trap set by a man who wants to catch a Jigglypuff for his daughter's birthday!
episodes.title: Rough, Tough Jigglypuff

episodes.synopsis: On their way to the Battle Arena, Ash and friends stop by a cake shop, but the line for it is long. They see an Arcanine come running by, and May decides to catch it. However, Drew returns and he also wants to capture it.
episodes.title: On Cloud Arcanine

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends rescue a sad Psyduck from a group of Fighting types, but they can't figure out how to cheer it up...
episodes.title: Sitting Psyduck

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes and Team Rocket check out a new restaurant owned by two sisters who can't stop squabbling!
episodes.title: Hail to the Chef!

episodes.synopsis: After a scientific experiment goes awry, Ash and friends try to track down a Caterpie that has grown to enormous proportions!
episodes.title: Caterpie's Big Dilemma

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes are in Saffron City for May's first Pokémon Contest in the Kanto region-and her shady rival Harley is competing, too!
episodes.title: The Saffron Con

episodes.synopsis: The Saffron Pokémon Contest is under way! Can May win her first ribbon in the Kanto region?
episodes.title: A Hurdle for Squirtle

episodes.synopsis: Ash checks out the Fighting Dojo in Saffron City and ends up getting recruited as a new student!
episodes.title: Pasta La Vista!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends wander into a ghost town, where they try to help settle a dispute between a group of Ghost-type Pokémon and a group of Psychic-type Pokémon.
episodes.title: Fear Factor Phony

episodes.synopsis: When May's Munchlax gets sick, Ash and friends seek the help of a kindly couple who specialize in healing Pokémon...and who just happen to be James's Nanny and Pop-Pop!
episodes.title: Sweet Baby James

episodes.synopsis: After Brock's Mudkip evolves into a Marshtomp and causes some trouble, Ash and friends befriend an elderly medicine-maker and help her assistants fight off Team Rocket's thieving advances.
episodes.title: A Chip Off the Old Brock

episodes.synopsis: At the Battle Arena, Ash battles Frontier Brain Greta for his second Frontier Symbol!
episodes.title: Wheel of Frontier

episodes.synopsis: May helps the daughter of a family of Pokémon Egg ranchers start her own Pokémon Contest journey, and receives her own Pokémon Egg as a thank-you gift.
episodes.title: May's Egg-Cellent Adventure!

episodes.synopsis: May competes against a former rock'n'roll guitarist and band leader in the Silver Town Pokémon Contest for her second Kanto ribbon!
episodes.title: Weekend Warrior

episodes.synopsis: Taking a break from Ash's training regimen to do a little fishing, our heroes help a young woman keep the ownership of her family's lake from a land developer.
episodes.title: On Olden Pond

episodes.synopsis: At the Battle Dome, Ash challenges Frontier Brain Tucker, a master of both battle tactics and showbiz savvy, for his third Frontier Symbol.
episodes.title: Tactics Theatrics!!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to the Battle Pike, Ash and friends meet a supercharged Elekid who's on a rampage, attacking everything in sight--including Max!
episodes.title: Reversing the Charges

episodes.synopsis: The Mythical Pokémon Celebi has been injured in the forest, and Ash and friends, along with a Pokémon Ranger, nurse Celebi back to health.
episodes.title: The Green Guardian

episodes.synopsis: On their way to the Battle Pike, our heroes come across a Pokémon ninja school, where they help the students rescue their Pokémon from Team Rocket's clutches.
episodes.title: From Cradle to Save

episodes.synopsis: At an abandoned train station, May meets a woman who lost the love of her life thanks to a sad twist of fate.
episodes.title: Time Warp Heals All Wounds

episodes.synopsis: At the Battle Pike, Ash must further hone his on-the-spot strategy skills to defeat a soft-spoken, fierce Frontier Brain named Queen Lucy and win his fourth Frontier Symbol.
episodes.title: Queen of the Serpentine!

episodes.synopsis: After arriving on Potpourri Island, our heroes discover the Pokémon Orienteering competition just about to take place and decide to enter, vying for the coveted Pokémon Teamwork medal!
episodes.title: Off the Unbeaten Path

episodes.synopsis: In the Wisteria Town Pokémon Contest, May discovers she is to compete against her old rival Harley.
episodes.title: Harley Rides Again

episodes.synopsis: As our heroes continue toward May's next Pokémon Contest, Ash's Grovyle finds itself nursing a crush on Nurse Joy's Meganium!
episodes.title: Odd Pokémon Out!

episodes.synopsis: After meeting a new Coordinator named Brianna who's a fan of hers and an even bigger fan of Drew's, May discovers she must battle her in order to win her third Pokémon Contest ribbon.
episodes.title: Spontaneous Combusken!

episodes.synopsis: After a frustrated Sceptile runs off into the forest, Ash and Pikachu go after it and run into a swarm of angry Beedrill--and the next Frontier Brain!
episodes.title: Cutting the Ties that Bind!

episodes.synopsis: It's time for Ash's next Battle Frontier challenge: a battle in the impressive outdoor arena at the Battle Palace, against Frontier Brain Spenser!
episodes.title: Ka Boom with a View!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Ash's next Battle Frontier challenge, our heroes come across a couple of Pokémon TV stars who aren't feeling well, so Brock's Bonsly and James's Mime Jr. act as stand-ins!
episodes.title: King and Queen for a Day!

episodes.synopsis: After hearing stories about many Trainers and Pokémon being defeated and taunted by a mysterious talking Pokémon known as Red Lightning, our heroes decide to find out what's really going on.
episodes.title: Curbing the Crimson Tide!

episodes.synopsis: When Brock meets up with a lovely Pokémon breeder who used to be a Coordinator, she talks him into competing against May in the Gardenia Pokémon Contest!
episodes.title: What I Did for Love!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to the Battle Tower for Ash's next challenge, our heroes come across a cute little Smoochum who is fiercely guarded by three Jynx, and Ash has to convince them he's on their side!
episodes.title: Three Jynx and a Baby!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to the Battle Tower, our heroes meet an amazing person who seems to be able to communicate with Pokémon by sensing their feelings...and more surprises await!
episodes.title: Talking a Good Game!

episodes.synopsis: After losing to Frontier Brain Anabel, Ash buckles down for some unusual special training--and Anabel joins him! Can he defeat her in the rematch?
episodes.title: Second Time's the Charm!

episodes.synopsis: After witnessing strange behavior from several kinds of Pokémon on their way to Pewter City, our heroes and Pokémon Ranger Solana encounter an electromagnetic disturbance, which leads them to the discovery of a troubled Deoxys!
episodes.title: Pokémon Ranger! Deoxys' Crisis!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Ash's final Frontier Battle and Brock's hometown of Pewter City, our heroes discover a wandering golden Sudowoodo and the estranged Trainer who caused its unusual coloring.
episodes.title: All That Glitters Is Not Golden!

episodes.synopsis: May is going after her fifth Contest Ribbon to qualify for the Grand Festival, but when her shady rival Harley teams up with Team Rocket, things don't look good!
episodes.title: New Plot, Odd Lot!

episodes.synopsis: After a shaky start in the Mulberry Pokémon Contest, May makes it through to the finals, where she goes up against "Jessebella"--Team Rocket's Jessie in disguise!
episodes.title: Going for Choke!

episodes.synopsis: After a squabble causes Jessie and James to part ways, they team up with fellow Team Rocket agents Butch and Cassidy for a Poké Ball-swiping scheme!
episodes.title: The Ole' Berate and Switch!

episodes.synopsis: Upon arriving in Pewter City, our heroes learn that Brock's old Gym is being remodeled by none other than Team Rocket in disguise, and Brock and Ash must battle them to put a stop to it!
episodes.title: Grating Spaces!

episodes.synopsis: In the ancient ruins beneath the Battle Pyramid, Ash is mysteriously possessed by the spirit of an ancient and evil king, who challenges Frontier Brain Brandon to a battle for all of his Pokémon.
episodes.title: Battling the Enemy Within!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to the Grand Festival, our heroes help a berry farmer reclaim his stolen crop.
episodes.title: Slaking Kong!

episodes.synopsis: As the Grand Festival gets under way at the Indigo Plateau, May has her hands full trying to compete with the best Coordinators in the world, including Harley, Drew, and new friend Solidad!
episodes.title: May, We Harley Drew'd Ya!

episodes.synopsis: The Grand Festival is going strong as May faces down one impressive competitor after another!
episodes.title: Thinning the Hoard!

episodes.synopsis: May faces Drew in the quarterfinals of the Grand Festival, and the two seem to be very evenly matched! Can May come out ahead?
episodes.title: Channeling the Battle Zone!

episodes.synopsis: On their way to Ash's rematch with Brandon at the Battle Pyramid in Fennel Valley, our heroes come across a village taking part in the annual ritual of choosing a king, and Ash's Aipom becomes a most unwilling candidate!
episodes.title: Aipom and Circumstance!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes meet an aspiring comedian named Audrey and her showbiz sidekick and Pokémon partner, Chatot.
episodes.title: Strategy Tomorrow - Comedy Tonight!

episodes.synopsis: Our heroes find themselves embroiled in Pokémon politics as two Weavile face off for leadership of a group of Sneasel!
episodes.title: Duels of the Jungle!

episodes.synopsis: When our heroes arrive at the Battle Pyramid for Ash's battle with Brandon, they discover a Nurse Joy who's a big fan of Ash and May!
episodes.title: Overjoyed!

episodes.synopsis: After their recent defeats in important matches at the Battle Pyramid and the Grand Festival, Ash and May are feeling a little down, until several old friends come together to support them.
episodes.title: The Unbeatable Lightness of Seeing!

episodes.synopsis: When Nurse Joy becomes too ill to take care of the Pokémon Center, our heroes pitch in, coming to the aid of a Pokésitter and his charges after a bus accident.
episodes.title: Pinch Healing!

episodes.synopsis: Ash prepares for his final rematch with Brandon at the Battle Pyramid by rounding up the Pokémon he's been with the longest, spending his time sharing old memories with them and training intensely.
episodes.title: Gathering the Gang of Four!

episodes.synopsis: Ash has lost to Brandon in two previous battles, and now his Charizard has been defeated! Can he battle back to claim the final Frontier Symbol?
episodes.title: Pace - The Final Frontier!

episodes.synopsis: Ash has beaten the Battle Frontier, but his competitive spirit won't let him rest for long, and he and May both sign up for an unofficial Pokémon Contest in Terracotta Town!
episodes.title: Once More with Reeling! (1)

episodes.synopsis: After one last contest battle between Ash and May, our heroes go their separate ways, and Ash discovers his next adventure!
episodes.title: Home Is Where the Start Is! (2)
